re-afforestation: the restoration (replanting) of a forest that had been reduced by fire or cutting
re-experiencing: a recurrence of a prior experience
re-formation: forming again (especially with improvements or removal of defects); renewing and reconstituting
re-introduction: a proposal of something previously rejected
re-sentencing: (law) the reduction in severity of a punishment imposed by law
re-uptake: a process of using up or consuming again
re-address: put a new address on (an envelope), as for forwarding
re-afforest: reestablish a forest after clear-cutting or fire, etc.
re-assume: take on again, as after a time lapse
re-create: form anew in the imagination; recollect and re-form in the mind
re-examine: question after cross-examination by opposing counsel
re-start: start an engine again, for example
